meta_title: TokenMeter — AI Usage Monitor for Windows
meta_description: TokenMeter is a lightweight Windows 10/11 app for monitoring Codex and Cursor quotas, plus DeepSeek, Xiaomi MiMo, and NayutoAI token usage, costs, balances, and history.
hero_title:
Your AI usage,
clear at a glance.
hero_lead: See subscription quotas, token consumption, costs, and account balances together—so every AI session stays measurable.

quota_image_alt: TokenMeter Codex quota panel with seven-day token usage and annual activity
screenshot_caption: Real UI · Demo data · Click for full size
providers_intro: Switch between popular AI services in one panel
features_intro: No more switching between provider consoles. Keep quotas, usage, and trends on your desktop.
benefit_1_desc: See used and remaining percentages, plus reset times for Codex and Cursor.
benefit_2_desc: See API token breakdowns, costs, balances, and historical changes.
benefit_3_desc: The floating widget and system tray stay within reach without interrupting your work.
benefit_4_desc: Explore intraday trends, historical totals, token breakdowns, and activity data.
benefit_5_desc: Usage history is cached locally, while sensitive credentials stay in Windows Credential Manager.
benefit_6_desc: Choose light or dark mode, accent colors, opacity, five interface languages, and an optional desktop pet.
screenshots_title: The right numbers, in the right place.
screenshots_intro: Subscription services show quotas. API services show tokens, costs, and balances—without mixing unlike metrics.
analytics_desc: DeepSeek, Xiaomi MiMo, and NayutoAI offer views for usage, costs, balances, and history. Some intraday data is estimated from refresh intervals, and its status is clearly labeled.

floating_desc: Drag the floating widget, resize it with the mouse wheel, or tuck it against the screen edge. Click for details when needed; otherwise, it stays quietly on your desktop or in the system tray.
floating_point_2: Edge hiding and system tray mode
pet_title: Want more personality? Switch to a desktop pet.
pet_desc: The VPet extension can replace the floating widget, show quota bubbles, and respond to clicks, dragging, and autonomous activity. It is installed separately; disabling or uninstalling it restores the floating widget without affecting accounts or the main panel.

privacy_title: Credentials, cache, and display data stay separate.
privacy_intro: TokenMeter has no account proxy service of its own. Your PC sends requests directly to each provider.
privacy_1_desc: Settings, cache, and usage history are stored on your device, with history saved in SQLite.
privacy_2_desc: API keys, bearer tokens, and cookies managed by TokenMeter are stored in Windows Credential Manager, not in regular config files or application logs.
privacy_3_desc: Usage queries go to the selected provider or an HTTPS endpoint you configure; update checks go to GitHub Releases.
privacy_4_desc: TokenMeter's first-party code is available under the MIT License, so you can inspect the implementation and commit history.
privacy_footnote: Codex and Cursor reuse their respective clients' local sign-in data. When one-click sign-in is used to obtain a cookie or bearer token, a dedicated Chrome or Edge session may retain the provider's sign-in state in a local data directory. This static site includes no analytics scripts and cannot read TokenMeter's local data. SHA256 verifies download integrity; it is not an independent release signature.
install_title: Three steps to put usage on your desktop.
install_1_desc: Get the latest Windows x64 installer and checksum file from GitHub Releases.
install_2_desc: Codex and Cursor can reuse local sign-in data; enter the corresponding credentials for other providers.
install_3_desc: Click the floating widget to open the panel. Settings are saved automatically, and data refreshes every 60 seconds by default.
open_title: Built for people who use AI tools every day.
open_desc: Free to download. TokenMeter's first-party code is available under the MIT License. Feedback and contributions are welcome.
footer_desc: AI token usage and subscription quota monitor for Windows.
theme_image_link_aria: View the full-size custom theme panel
theme_image_alt: TokenMeter panel with a custom brand-blue theme
download_desc: Download the Windows x64 installer, choose a provider, and click the floating widget to view usage.
advantage_multi_desc: Check multiple AI platforms in one app instead of opening separate dashboards, with a consistent way to read quotas and usage.
advantage_security_desc: API keys, tokens, and cookies managed by TokenMeter are stored in Windows Credential Manager—not plain configuration files or application logs.
advantage_tray_desc: Check quota or balance without opening the full panel; edge docking keeps it out of the way while you work.
